desc:
🌲 Something is hiding in Awe Park.

Following a series of mysterious disappearances, you have been sent to uncover the truth and capture a creature called Bigfoot. But once you enter the forest, you might become the one being hunted.

🔦 Explore alone or team up with friends.
🎒 Search for weapons and supplies, with loot locations changing every match.
👤 Unlock characters and upgrade your skills.
🐾 Play as Bigfoot and hunt down the travelers.

Good luck, and happy hunting…


Headphones recommended.
Developed by Nightfall Interactive Studio.
